WITH trans_with_region AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    t.type,
    t.amount
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
account_sums AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    region,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
      WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
      ELSE 0
    END) as account_sum,
    COUNT(*) as trans_count
  FROM trans_with_region
  GROUP BY account_id, region
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(account_sum) as region_total
  FROM account_sums
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  a_s.account_id,
  a_s.region,
  a_s.account_sum,
  a_s.trans_count,
  CAST(a_s.account_sum as REAL) / CAST(r_t.region_total as REAL) as share
FROM account_sums a_s
INNER JOIN region_totals r_t ON a_s.region = r_t.region
ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC
LIMIT 10
